entities.summary: Ruth Elizabeth Becker was one of the last survivors of the RMS Titanic disaster. Born in British India to American missionary parents, she boarded the Titanic in 1912 with her mother and siblings en route to the United States to seek medical care for her younger brother. During the sinking on April 15, 1912, Becker was separated from her family but survived.
